images.title: Signs between four numbers, always even?
images.purpose: Shows two tries of placing signs between four consecutive numbers, both giving even results, and asks if this always happens.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two short expression lines stacked in the centre, each ending in a green tag, with one question tag below.
images.exact_structure: Two lines of large dark text, one above the other, centred. Line 1: 3 + 4 − 5 + 6 = 8. Line 2: 5 − 6 − 7 − 8 = −16. The plus and minus signs in both lines are drawn in reddish purple (#CC79A7) so the placed signs stand out; the numbers are dark. To the right of each line, one rounded green (#009E73) tag with the word even, so exactly 2 tags. Below both lines, centred, one amber (#E69F00) outlined rounded box with the text always? Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Two tries both give even results; the chapter asks whether it always happens.
